envelope.rotor_source: provisional engineering allowance; measured blade sweep unavailable
envelope.asset_audit: composed HopperCalibrated20261028.usda: body/arms/motors/base/leg/rod/foot collision present; rotor sweep absent

envelope.rotor_enclosure: 32-sided circumscribed disk prism, same100mm engineering radius and8mm half-height

initialization: v23 stationary73D source; fold formerly duplicate target weights into Pt,zero distinct Pnext columns only; retain ring8/normalizers/recurrent heads/std; fresh optimizer/iteration0
termination: physical death or15s; retain targets and histories across nonterminal landing attempts
reward: Retain v23 flight,height,landing,precision and stability rewards without reweighting; strict target queue advance only. No ring rewards,collisions or B1-B4 power/progress additions.
evaluation: One seed7001/128 first15s mixed64+64 response evaluation after user training; full360deg first moving-edge coverage; report moving first-attempt and retry metrics separately.

vertical_pretraining.promotion: single fixed1m target throughout training; no0.6m/0.8m levels or promotion gate
vertical_pretraining.boundary: new level applies only on episode reset; existing target and release stay fixed within each episode
vertical_pretraining.unchanged: 73D interface,4direct motors,calibratedv2 physics/DR,delay/lag,LSTM,PPO,15s; no control assists

jump_cycle_reward.height_quality: 1.02m Gaussian/squared-rise quality remains only in event XY/goal shaping; flight height/apex use native dense kernels
jump_cycle_reward.events: XY/goal only at complete touchdown; reference_flight_reward overrides energy/height/apex and positive foot payment
jump_cycle_reward.energy: overridden by reference_flight_reward: native positive continuous energy feedback at1.04m
jump_cycle_reward.completion: goal/landing completion bonus requires apex>=1m, foot error<=10cm and tilt<=15deg; graded XY/apex shaping remains available below1m

attitude_refinement.scope: after initial contact, including ground preparation/ascent/apex/descent; physical terminals excluded
attitude_refinement.units: tilt radians squared, body wx/wy radians-per-second squared; both multiplied by control dt
attitude_refinement.rationale: case115 oscillates in free ascent while touchdown attitude is small; baseline angle/rate penalties underweight whole-flight motion

leg_swing_penalty.signal: actual SpringLeg link-origin velocity minus root-link-origin velocity, world XY, m/s
leg_swing_penalty.scope: post-drop CANDIDATE or FLIGHT; q<=1mm; alive; no motor/action/observation changes
leg_swing_penalty.purpose: suppress leg-tip whipping from roll/pitch rotation while excluding common horizontal translation and vertical spring speed

yaw_refinement.scope: after first contact, entire cycle; alive; same zero heading as current release and native yaw reward
yaw_refinement.error: atan2(sin(yaw-target),cos(yaw-target)), quaternion wxyz, heading in world frame
yaw_refinement.observation: existing quaternion/body angular velocity already supply both signals; OBS73 unchanged
yaw_refinement.metrics: post-drop heading-error RMS, yaw-rate RMS and per-episode peak heading; strict1m criterion unchanged

reference_flight_reward.continuous: Native positive continuous energy centre1.04m retained; dense height/apex reward centres1.04m with unchanged scales/widths/dt; command1m and strict1m unchanged
reference_flight_reward.landing: 6*exp(-0.5*(e_foot/0.05m)^2), once, gated at1m/10cm/15deg; no first-two multiplier for this stationary task
reference_flight_reward.underheight: -50*relu(1m-final_peak), once at valid touchdown, independent of foot error/tilt; initial drop excluded
reference_flight_reward.intentional_difference: XY/goal remain once at touchdown (existing cycle quality), to avoid paying for stationary hovering;73D/v2 physics and existing stabilizers retained
reference_flight_reward.evidence_limit: Historical stable37D stationary results are design references, not a performance guarantee for73D under calibratedv2 physics
reference_flight_reward.margin_rationale: v18 fixed64+64 gate:148 jump5+ under1m,127 within1cm; align dense height/apex centre1.04m with unchanged1.04m energy centre. Strict height command/threshold1m unchanged.
reference_flight_reward.margin_validation: CPU config/kernel/checkpoint-interface checks only; user-started training and one new fixed128 evaluation required

rotation_work_penalty.signal: sum over body x,y of max(actual delayed/lagged applied motor torque_i * body omega_i,0), watts
rotation_work_penalty.scope: post-drop CANDIDATE/FLIGHT, spring q<=1mm, alive; contact/drop excluded
rotation_work_penalty.reward: -500*sum(relu(tau_i*omega_i)*retained_factor_i)*dt, i=roll,pitch; legacy factor1 below10deg, during outward motion or non-restoring torque. For net tilt-decreasing recovery, factor ramps1->0.25 from10->20deg; braking remains zero cost; never positive.
rotation_work_penalty.coefficient_source: existing ring targeted pitch_work_weight=500; extend identically to roll, no sweep
rotation_work_penalty.evidence: v9 case62 bounded15s replay:15 completed hops,5 pitch spans>10deg,max16.31deg; worst hop pitch rate1.886rad/s,positive pitch work0.002594J (new cost1.297); no claim of exact fixed128 replay
rotation_work_penalty.unchanged: v8 height/energy/apex/foot/leg/tilt/yaw costs,1m/10cm/15deg scoring,OBS73,4motor actions,calibratedv2 physics/DR,15s,LSTM/PPO
rotation_work_penalty.validation_limit: Reward wiring/startup only until manual PPO training and one fixed128 evaluation; improvement not yet established

flight_quality.scope: CANDIDATE/FLIGHT q<=2mm and abs(spring_qdot)<=0.05m/s; initial drop and impact/compression transients excluded; existing stationary free-spring-rate criterion
flight_quality.payment: Once valid touchdown: subtract (1-quality)*(positive event XY+goal+foot); no extra dt factor; strict scorer unchanged
flight_quality.rationale: v10 case59 bounded replay hop2 pitch_span20.86deg still strict with touchdown tilt4.20deg/foot4.02cm; final pose alone misses air oscillation
flight_quality.threshold_basis: 5deg matches existing mean-pitch-span target;0.35rad/s permits normal v10 rates near0.29rad/s with roll allowance while downweighting0.8rad/s whipping; no sweep
flight_quality.unchanged: v10 height/energy/apex/K50,all existing costs,PPO,OBS73,4direct motors,calibratedv2 physics/DR,15s; no CTBR/LQR/controller
flight_quality.validation_limit: Reward behavior/startup only; needs user-started training and one new checkpoint evaluation; no stability claim

settled_pitch_refinement.reward: jump5+: retain Q_v12 and all original precision payments; add -4*(1-exp(-0.5*((relu(pitch_span-3deg)/3deg)^2+(relu(pitch_rate_RMS-0.2)/0.2)^2))) once valid landing; no dt factor
settled_pitch_refinement.scope: same genuine free-spring flight samples as v12; q<=2mm and abs(qdot)<=0.05m/s, initial drop/contact impulses excluded
settled_pitch_refinement.rationale: v15 recovered later strict93.05%,foot P95=4.77cm and0deaths, but pitch4.29deg/0.230rad_s misses3deg/0.2 targets; increase only independent cap2->4, warm-start v15; not a demonstrated improvement
settled_pitch_refinement.unchanged: first4/base Q_v12/height1.02m/energy1.04m/K50/foot5cm Gaussian/strict1m-10cm-15deg/all existing costs/PPO/OBS73/direct motors/physics/DR/15s retained; no v13 bonus
settled_pitch_refinement.eligibility: valid confirmed jump5+ even if below1m or inaccurate; genuine free-flight pitch samples; initial drop, repeated contact, physical terminal and first4 have zero new cost
settled_pitch_refinement.validation_limit: Config/reward-bound checks only; user-started training and one new fixed128 evaluation required; simulation gates do not establish hardware readiness

settled_evaluation.scope: jump5+ across all128 first15s episodes; every episode must provide>=4 later landings; deaths count across entire episode; first4 strict gate retained as legacy diagnostic only

response_robustness.training: At each episode reset,50% keep original DR; other50% multiply roll/pitch motor torque response by one shared episode-persistent gain sampled uniformly0.5..1.0, via existing dr_inertia_multi division. Yaw response,thrust,motor lag/delay and all nominal physical parameters are retained.
response_robustness.evaluation: One seed7001/128-case evaluation only: fixed cases0..63 original response,64..127 cover weaker-response gain midpoints. Saved release/base DR restored; gains/base multipliers saved explicitly. Both64-case strata must meet existing jump5+ precision/stability criteria. This is not the previous all-nominal128-case benchmark.
response_robustness.evidence: 20261112_153719 real trace, one frozen model/80ms free-flight windows: torque direction correlation roll0.917,pitch0.896; response amplitude ratio to nominal0.60/0.54 under nominal inertia. Hardware confirmed unchanged. Not a unique physical identification.
response_robustness.interpretation: Engineering uncertainty envelope, not a claim that motor force/inertia is identified at half/double nominal. Do not transplant this gain into live deployment.
response_robustness.unchanged: OBS73;four direct motors;LSTM/history/std;calibratedv2 nominal mass/inertia/spring/thrust;100Hz and motor timing;15s training episodes;1m goal and v17 reward coefficients;PPO

flight_braking.evidence: v19 case75 bounded234tick trace: prior to hop1 touchdown wx/wy=-1.336/-1.272rad_s; hop2 late-descent roll14->25deg with near-zero motor outputs; impact roll rate jumps0.69->14.98rad_s. Coupled roll/pitch failure, not a proof of insufficient motor torque.
flight_braking.scope: Post-drop CANDIDATE/FLIGHT; foot sphere above floor; spring<=1mm and abs(qdot)<=0.05m_s; alive. Outward cone-tilt rate ramp3->5deg; prelanding rate excess over0.35rad_s only while descending within final0.3m foot clearance. Initial drop/contact/physical terminals excluded.
flight_braking.rationale: Reuse existing roll_pitch_rate_weight4 and flight_quality free rate0.35;3deg settled target/5deg original quality; final30cm gives about100ms before3m_s impact. Engineering choice, no sweep or convergence claim.
flight_braking.boundary: No thrust or action penalty; no positive recovery bonus. Outward term is zero for decreasing cone tilt; prelanding rate term also encourages stopping rapid recovery before contact. Retain v19 work-cost relief and all height/precision rewards.

near_upright_braking.scope: Post-drop CANDIDATE/FLIGHT, foot above floor, spring<=1mm and abs(qdot)<=0.05m/s, alive. Full cost at cone tilt<=3deg, linear taper to zero at6deg; yaw excluded.
near_upright_braking.reward: -4*clip((6deg-cone_tilt)/3deg,0,1)*relu(norm(body_wxy)-0.35rad/s)^2*dt; includes both sides and exact upright; no positive payment or motor modification.
near_upright_braking.evidence: v22 case94 one bounded344-tick replay: third hop pitch+0.80deg with body pitch rate-2.39rad/s at2.64s; delayed actual pitch torque reverses after the upright crossing; overshoot then low-output descent and tilted impact.
near_upright_braking.coefficient_basis: Reuse v20 roll/pitch rate weight4 and free-flight quality/braking free rate0.35;3deg settled attitude target, taper out at twice that angle. Single engineering choice; no sweep.
near_upright_braking.boundary: Extra cost is zero at tilt>=6deg and normal slow rates; initial drop, contact and physical-terminal samples excluded. Existing large-angle recovery relief and all height/precision/PPO/physics/DR/OBS73/direct-motor contracts retained.
near_upright_braking.validation_limit: Reward wiring and zero-update startup only; improvement requires user-started training and one new fixed128 evaluation.

v23_notes: Start from zero-death v20, not v21/v22. Only near_upright_braking added; no pitch_corridor, position plateau or span tail. Manual training only; no deployment update.

omni.first_target: releaseXY origin; first post-drop hop is stationary, next landing point already visible
omni.advance: Strict valid post-drop landing only; miss retains current and next targets for retry, no logical failure termination. Jump histories/LSTM retained across goal changes.
omni.sampling: Uniform radius0.12..0.20m and heading0..2pi,10% exact-zero holds; pre-generated32-point per-episode route, bounded0.6m workspace with max8 angular retries then inward fallback. Queued points never move.
omni.evaluation_first_edge: First moving edge is nonzero, balanced16 cases per each of8 heading sectors; later edges use training distribution. All128 first episodes including misses/deaths remain denominator.
omni.transition: Only short omnidirectional bridge. Later0.4m/0.6m and ring reintroduction require separate configurations and actual evaluation; no automatic distance escalation.
omni.historical_reference: Stage4a/4b pre-visible Pt/Pnext and strict-hit queue with retry;41D weights/obs scaling/oldmulti-seed/hash workflow not imported.
